name: @equin/plugin-primitives-dom-static-render
description: One static render of a pane to HTML for robots (never hydrated): createStaticRenderer declares the process a static render, loads the plugins, hydrates a boot snapshot through the real hydrate path, and renders a path through the real provider stack and a static pane store (react-dom/static), failing loudly with the pane and component path; semanticHtml filters the markup down to its semantic document (headings, prose, lists, links — data-link controls become <a href> — tables, figures, images with alt).
